additional_prohibitions: Any employee, officer, contractor, or agent of The Weather Company with access to, or the ability to influence, the collection, processing, or publication of snowfall observations for the official climate station for <area>.

Any employee, officer, contractor, or agent of the National Weather Service or the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration who measures, observes, records, quality-controls, or publishes snowfall or other climate observations for the official climate station for <area>, including staff of the responsible Weather Forecast Office.

Any contract weather observer, designated snowfall observer, or other person engaged to take or report official snowfall measurements at the official climate station for <area>, and any employee of the airport or facility operator at that station with responsibility for the observing site.
Any employee, officer, contractor, or agent of a Source Agency listed in Appendix A with access to material nonpublic information relating to the Underlying.
Any person who otherwise has the ability to influence, or has advance knowledge of, the official daily snowfall recorded at the official climate station for <area> before its publication.
The immediate family members and members of the same household of any person described above

important_info.markdown: **Scalar payouts:** Each city has its own snowfall threshold, payout range and closing time. YES pays $0–$1 according to that city’s payout schedule; NO pays the remainder. Select a city to see its rules, payout schedule and timestamps.

series.title: Cumulative snow days in cities

markets.early_close_condition: Expiration may move earlier under the contract when the underlying or payout is definitively determined.
markets.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays according to a Directional linear payout from $0.00 at 0 qualifying days to $1.00 at 4 days, capped at $0.00–$1.00 and rounded down once to $0.01 based on the number of days between December 1, 2026 and April 1, 2027 with at least 0.1 inches of official daily snowfall in Atlanta (Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, KATL). Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Days run midnight–midnight in EST (UTC-05:00), fixed standard time; dates are inclusive. Trace snow counts as zero.

Trading close: April 2, 2027 at 12:59 AM EDT (April 2, 2027 at 12:59 AM EDT). Observation ends one minute later.

Payout: Round YES down to $0.01 increments; NO pays $1 minus YES. Each city settles independently.
